import hashlib
import json
import os
import runpy
import socket
import sys
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from uuid import UUID

root = Path.cwd()
assert (root / "tests/fixtures/self_grace_233/audio/evidence_support.py").is_file()
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / "tests/fixtures/self_grace_233/audio"))
import evidence_support

@dataclass
class SyntheticValue:
    identity: UUID
    path: Path

identity = UUID("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000233")
assert evidence_support.plain(SyntheticValue(identity, Path("synthetic"))) == {"identity": str(identity), "path": "synthetic"}
archive = root / "tests/fixtures/self_grace_233/publication_preformat.zip"
assert evidence_support.digest(archive) == "f93c22854120db3a161d8054ea41b4cf62a5673dd688c0e3e1d06f35bbd5fa67"
summary = runpy.run_path(str(root / "tests/fixtures/self_grace_233/audio/summarize_evidence.py"))
assert summary["distribution"]([]) == {"samples": 0}
assert summary["distribution"]([3, 1, 2]) == {"samples": 3, "min_ms": 1, "median_ms": 2, "mean_ms": 2, "max_ms": 3, "values_ms": [1, 2, 3]}
assert summary["sha256"](archive) == evidence_support.digest(archive)
os.environ.pop("SELF_GRACE_233_ISOLATED_ROOT", None)
try:
    runpy.run_path(str(root / "tests/fixtures/self_grace_233/experiment.py"))
except RuntimeError as exc:
    assert str(exc) == "Run this historical fixture through tests/fixtures/self_grace_233/run.py"
else:
    raise AssertionError("Historical fixture unexpectedly admitted the current tree")
evidence_support.install_network_guard()
assert socket.getaddrinfo("127.0.0.1", 0)
for host, port, message in [("example.invalid", 443, "Task probe forbids non-loopback network access"), ("127.0.0.1", 9000, "Task probe forbids default VRChat OSC ports")]:
    try:
        socket.getaddrinfo(host, port)
    except PermissionError as exc:
        assert str(exc) == message
    else:
        raise AssertionError("Expected network guard rejection")
print(json.dumps({"status": "passed", "checks": ["evidence serialization", "archive digest", "empty and populated summarizer distribution", "historical current-tree import rejection", "loopback lookup admission", "non-loopback lookup rejection before DNS", "default VRChat port rejection"], "network_connections": 0, "files_written": 0}))
